name: Stripe Payments
about: Payment processing only — no calendar or channel sync. A Stripe Payment Link is a ready-made payment page you create in a few clicks.
withLazy: Paste the Payment Link into your property's booking link on your Lazy account; the Book button on your site opens it.
bestFor: Taking deposits or full payment for stays you confirm yourself.
price: 2.9% + 30¢ per card payment, no monthly fee
services: Cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay

name: OwnerRez
about: Full vacation rental software: channel management, CRM, property management, accounting, messaging and websites, for single homeowners up to large managers.
withLazy: Paste your OwnerRez booking widget or link into your Lazy account; the Book button on your site opens it.
bestFor: Hosts who want one system for Airbnb, Vrbo and direct bookings, with agreements and accounting.
services: Channel manager: Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Google

name: Lodgify
about: A booking system with an embeddable booking widget: generate the code in Lodgify and paste it into any website to take bookings and payments, with calendar sync and channel management.
withLazy: Paste the Lodgify booking widget code into your Lazy account; it shows on your site as the booking box.
bestFor: Hosts who want a booking box with live availability right on their own site.
price: from about $16/month (yearly) or $23 month to month, per property; 1.9% booking fee below Ultimate

name: Hospitable
about: Automation-first software for short-term rentals: one inbox and calendar across Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, with automated messages; the Professional plan adds a direct booking site.
withLazy: Paste your Hospitable direct booking link into your Lazy account; the Book button on your site opens it.
bestFor: Hosts already on Airbnb who want messaging and turnovers on autopilot.
price: Professional about $59/month for 2 properties, $15 each extra

name: Guesty
about: Property management software; Guesty Lite is its plan for hosts with 1–3 listings, syncing Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo into one calendar and inbox.
withLazy: Paste your Guesty booking link into your Lazy account; the Book button on your site opens it.
bestFor: Small hosts who may grow into a larger property manager setup.
price: Guesty Lite from about $9/month per listing (1–3 listings)
